_note: Team knowledge file. Update and commit to git after each session to improve Scribe. Nothing in here is code — edit freely.

friday_fifty.name: Friday Fifty
friday_fifty.description: A weekly team standup. Each team member fills in three columns on a shared whiteboard: Progress (what was accomplished since last week), Plans (what is planned for next week), and Pitfalls (blockers, risks, or problems). Items are organised under each person's initials as a section header within each column.

brainstorm.name: Brainstorming Session
brainstorm.description: Free-form ideation session. Contributions are captured under three loose headings: Ideas (new proposals or suggestions), Challenges (obstacles, questions, or concerns), and Next Steps (agreed actions or owners). Strict per-person ownership is less important — many items may be shared or unattributed.

_glossary_note: Glossary is for Scribe's OCR disambiguation only. Terms are written as-is in the output — do not expand them.
